title: Integrate Monorepo Storybook And Playwright
summary: Repointed the workspace Playwright flow from Storybook smoke coverage to board-only end-to-end coverage, removed the monorepo smoke spec from the active runner, exposed the board renderer on the canvas for runtime-accurate board object targeting in Playwright, and fixed both board fixture stories so BoardCanvas receives marker elements directly instead of opaque React scene components. Validated with `bun nx run workspace:test-storybook` and all 4 board end-to-end tests now pass.
